precepts.text: Avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath; vengeance is mine, I will repay, saith the Lord.
precepts.point: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies; cut them off in thy truth. Vengeance belongs to the Most High, not to us.

note.label: Psalm 54: Save Me by Thy Name

precepts.why: “He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.” David leaves it to the Most High. “Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.” Vengeance belongs to the Most High, not to us. He rewards evil to the enemies and cuts them off; we give place unto wrath and let him repay.

precepts.text: Without faith it is impossible to please him; you must believe he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
precepts.point: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies; cut them off in thy truth. Vengeance belongs to the Most High, not to us.

note.label: Psalm 54: Save Me by Thy Name

precepts.why: “But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.” David says “He shall reward evil unto mine enemies” by faith. You must believe he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him. Leaving the vengeance to him takes that faith: believing he will reward, both the diligent and the enemies.

precepts.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen; we believe in the promises of the Bible.
precepts.point: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies; cut them off in thy truth. Vengeance belongs to the Most High, not to us.

note.label: Psalm 54: Save Me by Thy Name

precepts.why: “Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.” We believe in the promises of the Bible. David had not yet seen his enemies cut off when he wrote “He shall reward evil unto mine enemies”, but faith is the evidence of things not seen. Vengeance is the Most High's, and we hold the promise that he will repay as substance, even before we see it.

precepts.text: Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil; for thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
precepts.point: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble, and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies. We know the plans the Most High has to destroy them.

note.label: Psalm 54: Save Me by Thy Name

precepts.why: “For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.” Christ taught us to pray for the same: “lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.” Deliver us from evil is David's deliverance out of all trouble. And we know the plans the Most High has to destroy our enemies; the kingdom, the power and the glory are his for ever.

points: To the chief musician on Neginoth, Maschil, a Psalm of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us? Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
